title: Might as well use printer paper
text: Might as well use printer paper. These are worse than I imagined. When they say paper, they don't mean a nice heavy fiber sheet, they mean like cheap copier paper. The adhesive doesn't stick at all and the thing wrinkles like crazy. Returned!
